field.name: role
field.purpose: What a thread is for, so daemon.status can tell the code-indexing and document-summary threads apart (the summary worker serves no request class) and mark the unattributed and shared-state session workers, which ThreadStatus.cls and session alone cannot.

rationale: s4 ac4 lists each thread with its class and the session it serves, including the code-indexing and document-summary threads; ThreadStatus.cls is MethodClass | 'router', which gives both indexing threads the same value (the summary worker has no request class) and cannot mark the unattributed or shared-state session worker. One optional field fixes that without changing any existing field.
